prompt: Write validateSignup({ email, password, confirm }) in validate.js, exported by name. It returns an object with an entry for each invalid field and nothing for valid ones ({} when all is fine). Messages: email missing -> "Email is required"; email without exactly one @ with text on both sides and a dot in the domain -> "Enter a valid email"; password shorter than 8 -> "At least 8 characters"; password without a number -> "Include a number" (check length first); confirm different from password -> "Passwords don't match". Trim whitespace around the email before checking.
